words.gloss: when there is excess or transgression

literal: Laughing for the purpose is not making friendship; when there is excess, going forward and reproving is the purpose.
translation: Friendship is not made merely for the purpose of laughing and making merry; its true purpose is to go forward and sharply reprove a friend when they overstep bounds.
modern: நட்புச் செய்தல் என்பது கூடிச் சிரித்து மகிழ்வதற்காக மட்டும் அன்று; நண்பர் தவறு செய்யும்போது அவரிடம் சென்று கடிந்து அறிவுரை கூறுவதற்காகவே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true purpose of friendship. It states that friendship is not meant merely for pleasant socializing, laughter, and amusement (நகுதல்). Instead, when a friend exceeds proper bounds or commits a wrong (மிகுதி), the true duty of a friend is to step forward (மேற்சென்று) and boldly reprove or correct them (இடித்தல்). The word 'இடித்தல்' literally means crushing or pounding, which metaphorically signifies sharp, uncompromising correction rather than gentle, ineffective advice. Thus, true friendship involves the courage to correct a friend for their own good.
